description: This file defines the Error package for exception and error handling in Perl, including classes such as Error and Error::Simple, methods for throwing, catching, and managing errors, and overloads for error objects.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Base class for error objects, providing methods for error info, stack traces, and error management.

classes.name: Error::Simple
classes.description: Subclass of Error for simple textual errors with optional numeric value.

classes.name: Error::subs
classes.description: Provides procedural syntax for exception handling, including try, catch, finally, except, otherwise.

classes.name: Error::WarnDie
classes.description: Provides custom handlers for warnings and die signals to generate verbose or formatted error messages.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for Error objects, capturing caller information and setting up error details.

methods.name: throw
methods.description: Throws an Error object, causing it to be caught by surrounding try blocks or terminating the program.

methods.name: with
methods.description: Creates a new Error object with specified arguments for syntactic sugar.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Creates and returns an Error object, for recording an error without throwing.

methods.name: stacktrace
methods.description: Returns the full stack trace if debugging is enabled, otherwise basic info.

methods.name: associate
methods.description: Associates an error with an object for error propagation.

methods.name: stringify
methods.description: Overload method returning the error message as string.

methods.name: file
methods.description: Returns filename where error was instantiated.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Returns line number where error was instantiated.
